stade.name: Le terrain de foot · The soccer field
stade.alt: The village stadium during a children's soccer final, painted in ink and gouache: inside the gray stone oval with its blue-gray seats and red trim wall, a team in red huddles round a cardboard castle keep, a girl cheers through a tin funnel, the opposing captain in blue wears a diver's snorkel mask and a fan at the front wall hugs a fawn toy; Monsieur Verbe in a red beret catches the ball in a lobster trap in goal, another in a red beret misses his kick with a pet rat on his shoulder, and a third in a red beret blows the referee's whistle beside a puffed-up soufflé; a giant matchstick mascot waves by a striped snack stall, a soccer player dribbles in a bowler hat and a boy keeps a soup bowl on his head and the ball on his foot. The iron gate on the far left leads out to the boulevard, the stone steps beside it climb to the grandstand, the arched tunnel under the stall leads to the players' corridor and the green gate on the far right opens onto the running track.

doors.label: Les tribunes
doors.hint: Up the stone steps to the grandstand

doors.label: La piste
doors.hint: Out through the green gate to the running track

tribune.name: Les tribunes · The grandstand
tribune.alt: High in the gray stone grandstand at half-time, painted in ink and gouache: a girl climbs the steps with a bunch of balloons above a little potted tree, children run after a manta-ray kite, a kneeling girl offers a paper cone of currants to her neighbor; Monsieur Verbe in a green beret claps in a reindeer-antler headband and Monsieur Verbe in a red beret cheers with a foam hand and a blue jay on his shoulder; a granddad sits under a plaid blanket, the commentator in his striped-roof booth has a giant baked potato, a lady with a towering red-and-white shampoo-foam hairdo hugs a blue toy whale, a tour guide with a little flag leads two tourists with cameras and a photographer points his big lens at a grinning boy; a row of seats is painted like piano keys. The stone stairs with the iron rail on the left lead back down to the field.

doors.label: Le terrain
doors.hint: Back down the stone stairs to the pitch

piste.name: La piste d'athlétisme · The athletics track
piste.alt: The red athletics training track beside the stadium wall on a fresh morning, in ink and gouache: on the left girls race, one carrying a plate with a roast chicken, one bending to pick up a slice of cake from the lane, one running laps past a dewy spider web; a girl does push-ups on a teak bench; three Monsieur Verbe mimes in red berets sprint with a celery-stick baton, pedal a bicycle with a canoe paddle strapped on the back and dash off the long-jump runway beside an eland antelope; on the right a boy runs with a courier parcel, a tired marathon man passes a giant marrow on a weighing cart, a jogger carries a ginger cat on his shoulder, three boy cyclists ride past a huge pillow crash mat and a boy holds a stopwatch and an apple core; a hurdle is painted like a zebra. An arch in the stadium wall on the left leads back to the field; at the top right a path leads to the bunting-hung podium, and a green garden gate on the far right opens onto the pool and tennis courts.

doors.label: Le terrain
doors.hint: Back through the arch in the stadium wall to the pitch

doors.label: Le podium
doors.hint: Along the gravel path to the winners' podium

doors.label: Le complexe
doors.hint: Through the green garden gate to the pool and tennis courts

podium.name: Le podium · The prize-giving
podium.alt: A small gravel prize-giving square beside the athletics track at dusk, in ink and gouache, under red and blue bunting with warm lanterns: on the left girls celebrate, one dipping her medal ribbon into a pot of pink dye, one holding up a silver cup with a hen peeking out, one waving a giant leek and one in a frilly petticoat balancing an orange cone on her head; Monsieur Verbe in a red beret lowers a laurel wreath onto a little girl's head beside a neighing pony, and another red-beret Monsieur Verbe hoists a blue flag up the weathercock flagpole while a goose hisses at the rope; on the right a boy on the white podium eats peas from a pod, a champion holds a bouquet of pink peonies, a man in enormous glasses pins a rosette on the ranking board and a boy nibbles a corn cob; a table of medals and a bench stand at the far right. The gravel path between the hedges on the left leads back to the red track.

doors.label: La piste
doors.hint: Back along the gravel path to the athletics track

gymnase.name: Le gymnase · The gym
gymnase.alt: An enclosed indoor gym in ink and gouache, honey wooden floor, wall bars, blue mats and a colorful climbing wall with ropes: on the left girls twirl a pink ribbon on a candy stick, do the splits holding a soup bowl and leap over a green jelly; Monsieur Verbe in a red beret balances on the beam with a big gold key upright on his head, another climbs a thick rope while his gran waits below with an envelope, another scales the wall on scallop-shell holds and a fourth stretches high in a sparkly tiara; a boy in a mushroom T-shirt skips rope; on the right a boy does sit-ups holding two eggs, a man rows a toy-train rowing machine, the coach balances a tray of water cups and two boys swing horse chestnuts on strings at a low table beside a smiling vaulting horse. The green porthole double door on the left leads to the corridor; the wooden door with a ball knocker on the right leads to the clubhouse.

doors.label: Le couloir
doors.hint: the green double door with porthole windows

doors.label: Le club-house
doors.hint: the wooden door with the ball-shaped knocker

couloir.name: Le couloir des vestiaires · The players' tunnel
couloir.alt: The players' tunnel inside the stadium in ink and gouache, white and red tiles under strip lights: on the left a girl at the kit desk points at a big sparkling diamond on a cushion, two girls hold teacups under a wall TV and a girl in pink pulls a wooden toy ox on wheels; in the middle Monsieur Verbe in a red beret trips over a pink vanity case while a defender in red kit balances a china saucer on his head; on the right a equipment cart lies tipped on its broken axle with footballs rolling out, a boy pushes a toy car along the bench, a dad eats a sausage roll, a boy's torn jersey is snagged on a coat hook and a player carries a tower of folded towels. The gray push-bar double door on the left leads out to the stadium; on the right wall the green porthole door leads to the gym and the dark-blue door to the trophy room.

doors.label: Le terrain
doors.hint: the gray double door with the brass push bar

doors.label: Le gymnase
doors.hint: the green double door with porthole windows

doors.label: Le club-house
doors.hint: the small wooden door with the ball knocker at the far end of the corridor

trophees.name: La salle des trophées · The trophy hall
trophees.alt: The trophy hall inside the stadium in ink and gouache, deep blue walls, spotlights and a tall glass cabinet of silver cups: on the left a girl holds up coins she found on the bargain table of old jerseys, a girl unwraps a big shiny sweet and a girl sits on a basket piled with washed jerseys; in the middle Monsieur Verbe in a green beret lifts a gold trophy high beside a glowing crystal ball; on the right a man knocks on the cabinet under a stadium-shaped cuckoo clock, a boy licks a giant swirl lollipop beside a silver shield, a boy holds up a raisin tart at the results board, and on the low shelf a fairy figurine stands on an old trophy, a gingerbread man sits on a plate and a purple octopus toy guards eight tiny trophies. The dark-blue door with the porthole on the left leads back to the tunnel.

doors.label: Le couloir
doors.hint: the dark-blue door with the round porthole

club.name: Le club-house · The clubhouse
club.alt: The clubhouse games room inside the stadium in ink and gouache, dark wooden panelling, red-and-white tiles and green lamps: on the left a girl skips rope beside a metronome, a girl catches drips from the leaky ceiling in a bucket and a girl draws a sun with a yellow crayon; in the middle Monsieur Verbe in a red beret pumps up a soccer ball under a big brass gong and another pulls a tea-tray cart by a rope; on the right a bumble-bee balloon floats over the foosball table, a boy points at a grouper in the fish tank under a puffball mushroom puffing spores, a lion cub mascot sits on the bench, a boy wears a frilly shower cap, a boy flexes for a pose and a boy in a ghost sheet bowls at the pins. The wooden door with the ball knocker on the left leads back out to the players' corridor.

doors.label: Le couloir
doors.hint: the wooden door with the ball-shaped knocker, out to the players' corridor

complexe.name: Le complexe sportif · The sports park
complexe.alt: The open-air sports park among the trees in ink and gouache, bright midday sun: on the left a girl floats in the turquoise pool on a giant pea-pod lilo, a girl in a pink cap swims beside an inflatable walnut and a girl throws a beanbag at a target held by a toy bull; in the middle Monsieur Verbe in a red beret whooshes down the curly yellow water slide, another in a red beret throws a beach ball from a lawn deck chair, and one in a green beret watches his ball bounce off a cardboard deer with a red ribbon; on the right a boy in a swimsuit plays with a yo-yo, a boy plays tennis in big knee pads, a picnic basket hangs under the basketball hoop, a boy's boot flies off as he kicks toward the goal, a small boy runs in a giant foam foot and a frog gulps a golf ball on the mini-golf green. The green garden gate on the left leads back to the running track.

doors.label: La piste
doors.hint: the green garden gate, the red running track beyond
